products.name: Automation Anywhere
products.note: Intelligent automation platform; AI-powered bots; control room governance; credential vault

profile_text.body:
Automation Anywhere is a California-based software company founded in 2003 that describes itself as the number one provider of agentic automation. Its core platform combines artificial intelligence, robotic process automation, and what it calls agentic process automation to handle mission-critical enterprise workflows. The company positions its offering as distinct from generative AI products repurposed as agents, citing a Gartner observation that more than 90% of so-called agentic AI solutions are simply repackaged generative AI layered atop legacy systems.

The company's primary product is its intelligent automation platform, which includes AI-powered bots, a control room for governance, and a credential vault. A central component is the Mozart Orchestrator, which the company says coordinates AI agents, deterministic automations, and human workers to build and govern agentic solutions. Use cases highlighted on the site include IT service management, where the platform is described as able to boost employee self-service, reduce IT service desk workload, predict major incidents through AIOps, and lower costs.

The held facts for this site show 174 California law exposure records associated with the company, though no specific litigation cases are on file. The company has a verified profile on this site as of August 2026 and no MCP server presence is recorded.
